a chieftain or polegar of Ummattūr, a former fort in Karnataka, 44 km. of Kotagiri; he came to the Nilgiris, built Male Ko:ṭe , and early inthe 17th Cent. drove his brother Uḍdura:ya out to Nambala:ko:du (q.v.; certain chieftains of this family bore distinct titles, such as Cēra Cōla Pāṇdya, Nūvaru Räāyara Ganda, Nīlagiri Sādāra, Nīlagiri Nadālva; they were opposed to the rulers of the Vijayanagar Empire during the last three decades ofthe 15th Cent., and did not acknowledge the suzerainty of those kings, but were subdued by Kriṣșṇadëvarāya ca 1511; na:yaka; Macleane 1893: 246; Hockings 1980a:33-36; < Ummattu:r+arasu
